exposure: premature rupture of membranes (PROM) at term
cohort: Pregnant women with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) at term
finding: Active management of PROM at term with misoprostol resulted in significantly shorter latency and induction to delivery intervals compared to expectant management, but no significant differences in delivery outcomes or complications were observed.
mod_finding: While not statistically significant, the rate of cesarean section was lower in the expectant management group (21%) compared to the active management group (30%).
